_note: Grade 1 Word Meanings and Word Parts (English literacy year, Part 12.3; types/_shared/word-meanings-g1.js). General American. `cats`, `pairs`, `triples`, `things`, `odd`: the sort page G1-608 (cards with a picture and its word; every card belongs to exactly ONE category of the page; `odd` = cards of level 3 that fit no box, with the reason). `facts` + things[].main/sample/also: the definition page G1-609 (every attribute phrase with the things it is TRUE of and those a teacher might argue about). `bases`, `noEnding`, `sentences`, `read`, `names`, `own`: the endings pages G1-610 and G1-611 (each sentence judged against every form of its base). `say`: examples of the instructions. `bad`: words no page may print.

bat.why: A bat flies, but it has no feathers.
